text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Satono Diamond and I have come to watch Kitasan Black compete in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kita's on the track!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh… It looks like there's something off about her…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's nerves.
I think it's more likely because of who isn't running in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature suddenly appears from among the crowd. She's one of the students who threw Satono Diamond and the other newcomers a welcome party when they entered the academy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's right. You mean the person who won the Satsuki Sho and Japanese Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yep. She's not racing today, and it seems that Kitasan was all fired up about beating her here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It just doesn't quite feel worth it to try hard when your rival's not there, you know? It's kind of like when the star of a show is missing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The star…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kitaaa!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: She's completely focused on the race… Seems I was worrying for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm certain she'll put on a great performance and show everyone that she's the main star!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Yodo has become grounds for the Kitasan Festival as Kitasan Black conquers the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Kita was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa, seriously? I didn't know Kita was a shining star herself…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Although, it seemed like she struggled a bit with her positioning towards the end…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It always comes down to the final sprint for me, so I would've tried to avoid being trapped on the inside and pushed toward the outside on the fourth turn. Then—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, come on. Ugh. You're getting too dazzling for me too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after returning from watching the Kikuka Sho…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can keep going! I'm still worried about my endurance, so can we do some additional training, please?
choice_data_list: You're not ready to work on your endurance yet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Then, how about I do some incline dashes?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She passionately pleads her case, but since she's still in her junior year, I want to avoid any training that will put undue stress on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that putting too much strain on her body while she's still growing could lead to injury.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sorry… You're right. Seeing Kita run in the Kikuka Sho made me feel pressured to work harder too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like yesterday's race triggered something inside her, and now she's positively bursting with pent-up energy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there's a way for her to channel that energy productively without straining herself.
choice_data_list: How about we do some special training to break the school's jinxes?
How about we do some special training to break the school's jinxes?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's get started right away! Where can I find these jinxes?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wow. Talk about hook, line, and sinker. She's completely into it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay, what's the first jinx?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's rumored if you play milk caps on the school's rooftop and win, you'll slip on the stairs on the way down. Just as I take out some milk caps…
Oh, it's Satono and her trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ooh, what's that? Are you playing milk caps? Can we join? We're, like, sooo supes bored right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer approaches us excitedly, accompanied by Ikuno Dictus and Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'd be delighted to have you as opponents! I'm actually in the middle of undergoing special training to break jinxes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're training to… break jinxes? What does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ooh, so that's it. We'll help too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, we would be happy to. If it's school jinxes you're looking for, I know of around ten.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This is the jinx where if you win a game of milk caps on the rooftop, you'll slip on the stairs on the way down, yes?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: In other words, if Satono manages to win a game and make it down the stairs without slipping, then she'll have broken the jinx.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, aren't you really good at milk caps, Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I don't know if I'm good at it, but I do play it a lot. How are you at milk caps, Satono?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I haven't played it very much, but I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I think it's gonna be a toughie, winning against Nature…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ooh! You made it down the stairs without tripping!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That's one jinx down!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: There's another jinx where the person who buys the last juice box here is cursed with bad luck for the rest of the day.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a coincidence. This is the very last one, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: To check whether you have bad luck or not, the two of us will both draw raffle tickets.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ikuno drew the fourth prize ticket and Satono got the first. Well, you definitely don't have bad luck.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's the second jinx taken care of! I'm on a roll!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And that's ten! I've successfully broken ten jinxes in a row!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Overcoming ten jinxes is legit wild! Mad respect, Satono!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It's not that big a deal, really.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sure it is. It's awesome how you face everything head-on without backing down, whether it's a jinx or your family's dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're like McQueen in that way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so?! You just made my day!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've… I've always admired McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The way she moves stoically toward her goals while remaining unfazed even in the face of great pressure―that's how I aim to be.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Just as McQueen bore and met the expectations of the Mejiro family, I, too, wish to realize my family's dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You know, McQueen was complimenting you for working so hard to make your family's dreams true.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But I'm nowhere near her level yet. I haven't achieved anything remarkable so far.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Man… All you sparkly go-getters sure have it tough…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: We're rootin' for you, Satono, so do your best! Don't you dare lose!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I won't! Thank you!
